_meta.notes: All figures are from pages opened with WebFetch or WebSearch snippets on 2026-10-31. Deaths are inherently estimates; estimated=false only for direct counts (ISAF). Omitted for lack of a documented yearly figure: spotted_hyena, horse, cheetah, tsetse fly (WHO: <1000 reported cases/yr since 2018, no death count), box jellyfish (only cumulative totals: ~64 deaths in Australia 1884-2021).

deaths_per_year.note: UNODC Global Study on Homicide 2023: ~458,000 intentional homicide victims in 2021 (range since 2000: 400,000-450,000/yr). Homicide only, no wars. Figure from WebSearch snippet; press-release page itself returned 404.

ALL DOGS, not German shepherds: WHO rabies fact sheet (17 Sep 2026) - 44,203 human rabies deaths/yr (Global Health Estimates 2021), dogs transmit up to 99% of cases; WHO says true number likely higher. US direct dog-attack deaths ~43/yr (2011-2021, Wikipedia Dog bite).

Crocodiles overall ~1,000/yr (Wikipedia 'List of deadliest animals', 2016 media estimates). Nile crocodile article: older studies ~1,000 deaths/yr from Nile crocs; a more recent study 275-745 attacks/yr, 63% fatal (~175-470 deaths). Shaky, order of magnitude 'hundreds to a thousand'.

Study cited in Wikipedia (Nile crocodile, 'Attacks on humans'): ~30 saltwater crocodile attacks/yr, 50% fatal => ~15 deaths/yr. Australia: 106 deaths 1971-2013 (~2.5/yr); Sarawak 2.8/yr 2000-2003 (Wikipedia Saltwater crocodile). Likely underreported outside Australia.
~500/yr, all four sources in the Wikipedia list agree (CNET, Business Insider, BBC 2016; Discover Wildlife). Africa only. No primary count exists.

ELEPHANTS IN GENERAL (mostly Asian elephants): India govt figure 605 human deaths in 2022-23 (Ministry of Environment reply to Parliament; 1,500 killed 2019-2022 per Wikipedia Elephant). Worldwide older estimate ~500/yr (Wikipedia list, 2016). African-elephant-only figure not documented.

SHAKY. Wikipedia list: 250/yr (CNET 2016) vs 22+/yr (Business Insider). Only solid data: Tanzania, >563 killed 1990-2005 (Packer et al., Nature 2005) = ~22-70/yr in one country. Africa-wide total unknown; 'tens to a few hundred'.

India govt data (Parliament replies): 59 deaths in 2021, 103-110 in 2022, 82-85 in 2023, ~49 in 2019-2020. India holds ~75% of wild tigers; Bangladesh Sundarbans adds ~2-25/yr (Wikipedia Tiger attack). Worldwide total not published; ~80/yr is the India level of recent years.
NINA (Norwegian Institute for Nature Research) review: 498 attacks and 25 deaths worldwide 2002-2020, 14 of them from rabies => ~1.3 deaths/yr. Our World in Data: 'single-digit'.
ALL SHARK SPECIES, not only great white: ISAF five-year average 2020-2024 = 8 unprovoked fatalities/yr; 2025: 9 unprovoked fatal (65 unprovoked bites). Direct count of confirmed cases.
Komodo National Park records 1974-2012: 24 attacks, 5 fatal in 38 years => ~0.13/yr (roughly one death per 8 years).
Wilder et al. 2017: 73 recorded attacks and 20 deaths worldwide 1870-2014 => ~0.14/yr (about one death per 7 years).

Wikipedia Brown bear: 'around 10 people a year are killed by brown bears in Russia', more than the rest of the range combined; 2019 study (North America + Eurasia): 95 fatalities 2000-2015 (~6/yr). So roughly 6-15/yr worldwide.
SHAKY. No global database. Nepal study (2001): ~55 deaths/yr; India Uttarakhand 239 deaths 2000-2007 (~30/yr); Maharashtra 17 in 2022. Worldwide realistically 'dozens to ~100'.

deaths_per_year.note: Via malaria only: WHO malaria fact sheet (4 Dec 2025) - 610,000 malaria deaths and 282 million cases in 2024. Other mosquito-borne diseases (dengue etc.) add roughly 100,000 more (Our World in Data), not counted here. Body length 3-6 mm (Wikipedia Mosquito).

new.fun_fact: Змеи не слышат звуков, зато чувствуют малейшую дрожь земли всем телом.
new.hint: Их яд спасает жизни: из него делают лекарства и противоядие.

deaths_per_year.note: WHO snakebite fact sheet (17 Sep 2026): 81,410-137,880 deaths/yr, midpoint 109,645; 1.8-2.7 million envenomings/yr. All venomous species together. Face: saw-scaled viper (Echis carinatus, 38-80 cm) is one of India's 'big four' responsible for most snakebite deaths, but Wikipedia names no single deadliest species.

deaths_per_year.note: Via schistosomiasis: WHO fact sheet (23 Feb 2026) estimates 14,353 deaths/yr globally and says this is likely an underestimate. Media estimates range 10,000-200,000 (Wikipedia Freshwater snail).

deaths_per_year.note: Via Chagas disease: WHO fact sheet (8 Apr 2026) - 'more than 10,000 deaths every year', ~8 million infected.

deaths_per_year.note: USA ONLY: CDC NCHS - 788 deaths from hornet, wasp and bee stings 2011-2021, average 72/yr (death certificates, ICD-10 X23). No reliable worldwide figure found. Mostly allergic reactions.
